title: Section 24 — General power of transfer and withdrawal — CPC 1908

content.heading: General power of transfer and withdrawal
content.text: On the application of any of the parties and after notice, or of its own motion without such notice, the High Court or the District Court may at any stage transfer any suit, appeal or other proceeding pending before it or in any Court subordinate to it, or withdraw any such proceeding and try it itself or transfer it. Read the official clauses including compensation and Small Cause Court limits.
